description: Page-level state. Three DataType variants: Text (a scalar default), Json (an object default plus a JSON-Schema), and ObjectList (an array default plus a JSON-Schema) — the KPI-tile pattern is an ObjectList of {label,value,icon,color,iconColor}.
notes: Json and ObjectList both carry a Schema (JSON-Schema shape) alongside DefaultValue; Text carries neither.

Colours INSIDE a Variable's DefaultValue data (e.g. the KPI "color"/"iconColor" fields here) are design-TOKEN refs as plain strings ("Color.Primary.100"), even though the unrelated page Style.Value surface wraps colour refs in a {"ref": ...} object — two different serializations of the same token vocabulary depending on which surface holds it.
The KPI-tile pattern is this ObjectList shape feeding a Repeater component (see widget_repeater.json) whose template renders one card per array element.

A Variable is PAGE-scoped state (LHSType:"PageVariable" when a Condition reads it — see criteria_condition.json), structurally distinct from a VariableRef, which reads live datasource/repeater-item data rather than this static default (see variable_ref.json).
